statistics.scope: conditional on the frozen systems and archived latency replay; no training or fresh timing uncertainty

design.partial_results: Never present incomplete D coverage as a complete cohort or pool time steps as independent episodes
design.worker_policy: One sequential worker per source/step/method/mode; engine reset for each episode as in the original runner
